correctness.rationale: The regular 12-gon support norm is max of twelve unit outward facet functionals. Birkhoff-James support-cone analysis (edge interiors and vertex normal cones, using full dihedral symmetry) reduces all normalized chords to T_E,T_1,T_2. Convex combinations h_E,h_2 of adjacent facet normals and n_2 certify every triangle has norm at least d=(7+5sqrt3)/26. On chord from v11=(1,-(2-sqrt3)) to (0,1), the exact point (1,1)/(4-sqrt3) has norm d and is attained at lambda=3-sqrt3. Therefore μ=1/d=5sqrt3-7. Verified exact sqrt3 algebra and all triangle vertices from actual verify.py; finite symbolic checks support but do not replace the support-cone completeness argument.

Residual possibility of an unindexed older specific computation remains.
